views.title: App shell (authenticated chrome)
views.reach: Sign in and finish onboarding, then open any route except /workspace/$id, /gadget/$id, /signup and /connect/handoff (e.g. /, /workspaces, /explore). With Operate available, /workspace/<id>/inferops-canvas also gets the shell, while /inferops-canvas gets the console frame instead (operate.shell).
views.styling: Tailwind only. Outer flex row `bg-kumo-base`, desktop rail in `hidden md:flex`, main column `flex-1 flex-col` with `<main class="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">` for routed content. No CSS module.
views.notes: __root.tsx wraps it in AuthProvider > FeatureFlagsProvider > TooltipProvider > Toasty, and also mounts AccountSelectionModal (billing, other slice) beside it. The rail is replaced by a drawer below `md`. Whole app sits inside main.tsx's `.app-viewport` (position: fixed, top: var(--app-top)) under the AnnouncementBanner. With Operate available (`operate-mode` flag + composableViews) __root.tsx wraps the shell in OperateSessionProvider and ShellFrame: /workspace/<id>/inferops-canvas keeps this shell (Operate mode), /inferops-canvas in Operate mode drops the rail/top bar/palette for operate.shell, and a running flow renders it fullscreen.

views.title: Activity notifications popover
views.reach: Open a workspace and click the Activity (pulse) icon in the editor top bar. Pending requests (with approve/deny) need an agent action waiting for approval; otherwise shows 'Nothing is waiting on you.'.
components: local: CountBadge, ResolveButton, ActionFields, IncompleteDescriptionNotice, RestrictedApprovalNotice
views.styling: Trigger `h-8 w-8 rounded-md hover:bg-kumo-tint`, CountBadge `tone="solid"` pinned top-right. Content overrides Kumo with `!`-important utilities: `themed-floating-shadow !z-[1100] !w-[min(340px,calc(100vw-24px))] rounded-lg border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base !p-0 [&>:first-child]:hidden` (hides Kumo's arrow). Rows `px-3.5 py-2.5` with `border-t`; footer 'View all activity' row.
views.notes: Lives in the workspace editor top bar (GadgetEditor), not the AppShell. Restricted workspaces (containsRestrictedData) show a notice and full request text. Shows at most 3 requests.

views.title: Announcement banner (deployment-wide)
views.reach: As admin, set a banner text (and colour) in /admin; it appears full-width above every page, signed in or not. Dismiss with the X; it reappears when the text changes. Clear localStorage key `dismissedBanner` to see it again.
views.styling: Tailwind layout (`flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-kumo-line px-4 py-2.5`, centered `text-sm`). Colours come from an inline `style` map COLOR_STYLES per BannerColor (neutral/info/success/warning/danger/brand) using CSS vars like `--color-kumo-info-tint`, `--color-accent-100`, `--text-color-kumo-inverse`. Dismiss button `hover:bg-black/10` (hard-coded).
views.notes: Rendered in main.tsx outside the router, so it also shows on login, standalone and fullscreen editor screens. AdminPage duplicates the swatch colours (keep in sync).

views.title: Command palette (⌘K)
views.reach: On any shell route press Cmd/Ctrl+K, or click the Search (magnifier) button in the rail. Type to fuzzy-search workspaces, blueprints and actions.
views.styling: Custom (not a Kumo Dialog): overlay `fixed inset-0 z-[1500] pt-[12vh]`, scrim `bg-black/20` (hard-coded); panel `themed-floating-shadow-lg max-w-xl rounded-xl border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base`; input `h-12 text-[14px]`; group headings `text-[11px] uppercase text-kumo-inactive`; rows `h-10 rounded-lg`, active `bg-kumo-fill text-kumo-strong`; matched chars `font-semibold text-kumo-strong`; list uses `.sidebar-scroll`, `max-h-[min(60vh,420px)]`; footer legend strip.
views.notes: Intentionally no open/close animation. Empty query shows Actions + 4 recent workspaces; typing shows Actions/Workspaces/Blueprints groups. 'New <noun>' rows come from admin-configured output formats. Not mounted on /inferops-canvas in Operate mode (no ⌘K there).

views.title: Command palette – no results
views.reach: Open the palette and type a string matching nothing (e.g. 'zzzzqq').
views.styling: `px-3 py-6 text-center text-[13px] text-kumo-inactive` 'No results.'

views.title: Fullscreen editor frame (no chrome)
views.reach: Open any workspace (/workspace/<id>); legacy /gadget/<id> and /workspace/<id>/inferops-canvas (when Operate is unavailable) also use it. With Operate available, /inferops-canvas renders fullscreen while a flow runs.
views.styling: Just `<main class="h-full min-h-0">` around the outlet.
views.notes: Content belongs to the workspace editor / canvas / operate slices; listed so the CLI knows these routes have no rail/top bar. ShellFrame in __root.tsx decides: fullscreen = workspace path and not Operate mode, or a running operate flow on /inferops-canvas.

views.title: Sidebar (left rail)
views.reach: Any shell route at width >= md (768px).
components: local: SidebarItem, SidebarGatekeeperApps, SidebarWorkspacesProvider/Tools/Lists, SidebarUtilityStrip, SiteLogo, ModeToggle (features/operate)
views.styling: `flex h-full flex-col bg-kumo-elevated` (no border: it separates from the `bg-kumo-base` canvas by tone alone), width `w-[56px]` collapsed else `w-[min(320px,100vw)] md:w-[260px]`, `transition-[width] duration-200`. Scrolling middle uses global `.sidebar-scroll` (styles.css: thin scrollbar shown on hover/focus-within).
views.notes: Rail is `bg-kumo-elevated` vs content `bg-kumo-base`. Three pinned regions around one scroll region; with Operate available the Build | Operate toggle (shell.sidebar.mode-toggle) sits under the brand row. Not rendered on /inferops-canvas in Operate mode (operate.sidebar replaces it).

views.title: Sidebar – brand row
views.reach: Top of the rail on any shell route. Custom logo appears when admin sets a site logo.
components: local: SiteLogo (falls back to Phosphor Hexagon)
views.styling: `flex h-14 items-center` (no bottom border); site name `text-[14px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.25px] text-kumo-default`; icon buttons `h-7 w-7 rounded-md text-kumo-inactive hover:bg-kumo-tint`; search button uses global `.press` (active scale).
views.notes: SiteLogo renders object-contain at 20px or the brand hexagon if unset/failed.

views.title: Sidebar – collapsed rail
views.reach: Click the 'Collapse sidebar' button in the rail's brand row (persists in localStorage `gadgets:sidebar-collapsed` = '1'). Expand with 'Expand sidebar'.
components: local: SidebarItem (icon-only), SidebarWorkspacesTools (search icon), SidebarGadgetRow (monogram only)
views.styling: 56px wide; labels removed (title tooltips instead); utility strip becomes `flex-col` stack; compact list shows up to 8 monograms.
views.notes: Desktop only; the mobile drawer always renders expanded.

views.title: Sidebar – mobile drawer
views.reach: At width < md (768px), tap the hamburger ('Open menu') in the shell top bar. Closes on Escape, backdrop click, or navigation.
views.styling: Backdrop `fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-[1px]` (hard-coded black); drawer `fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50`; sidebar width `min(320px,100vw)`. Main column gets `inert` while open.
views.notes: Has a focus trap. Dropdown menus use z 1100 (MENU_POSITIONER_STYLE) to sit above it.

views.title: Sidebar – primary nav
views.reach: Pinned list under the brand row: Home, Workspaces, Blueprints, Outputs, [InferOps Canvas], [gatekeeper apps], Explore. 'InferOps Canvas' shows only with composableViews and Operate unavailable (the mode toggle replaces it).
components: Phosphor: House, SquaresFour, Blueprint, Stack, Kanban, BookOpenIcon, Compass
views.styling: Rows `h-11 md:h-8 rounded-lg px-2.5 text-[14px] md:text-[13px]`; active `bg-kumo-info-tint font-medium text-kumo-brand` with icon `text-kumo-brand`; idle `text-kumo-default hover:bg-kumo-tint`, icon `text-kumo-subtle`. Gatekeeper app icons (SidebarGatekeeperApps) are a `bg-current` span with inline CSS mask-image from the app's icon URL, falling back to BookOpenIcon.
flags: serverConfig.canvasFeatures.composableViews and not Operate mode (InferOps Canvas item)
connected gatekeeper apps with a UI (useGatekeeperApps)
views.notes: Active state is exact pathname match unless a caller passes `active`/`matchPrefix`; active rows carry aria-current=page. SidebarItem also accepts `search` and `onClick`. Larger touch targets below md.

views.title: Sidebar – bottom utility strip
views.reach: Bottom of the rail on any shell route: Gatekeepers plug link, theme toggle, avatar.
views.styling: `shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 bg-kumo-elevated px-3 py-2` (no top border; flex-col when collapsed); icon buttons `h-8 w-8 rounded-md text-kumo-inactive hover:bg-kumo-tint`, active Gatekeepers link `bg-kumo-fill text-kumo-brand`; theme button has focus ring `ring-kumo-ring ring-offset-kumo-elevated`.
views.notes: Theme button cycles system > light > dark; good place to test dark mode for the whole shell.

views.title: User menu (avatar dropdown)
views.reach: Click the avatar at the bottom-right of the rail. Admin item appears only for admins.
views.styling: Trigger `h-11 w-11 md:h-7 md:w-7 rounded-full bg-kumo-tint hover:bg-kumo-fill`, initials `text-xs font-medium text-kumo-strong`. Menu uses MENU_CONTENT / MENU_ITEM / MENU_ITEM_DANGER.
views.notes: Also rendered in the public Header when authenticated. Items: Profile, Providers, Admin, Sign out.

views.title: Sidebar – Favorites / Recent workspaces
views.reach: Scrolling middle of the rail. Needs workspaces to show rows; with none you see 'Favorite a workspace to keep it here.' and 'No workspaces yet.'. Section headers collapse on click.
views.styling: Section header `h-6 text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.06em] text-kumo-inactive`; empty copy `text-[12px] text-kumo-inactive`; 'Show all (N)' link `h-7 text-[12px] font-medium text-kumo-subtle hover:bg-kumo-tint`. Recent capped at 6.
views.notes: Provider (SidebarWorkspacesProvider) also owns the delete dialog and share modal. The search state exists but no input renders; search goes through the command palette.

views.title: Sidebar – delete / remove workspace dialog
views.reach: Workspace row ... menu > Delete (own workspace) or Dismiss (shared workspace: title 'Remove workspace').
views.styling: Styled by the shared DeleteConfirmationDialog component (also used elsewhere); this entry only configures copy.
views.notes: Shared dialog; style changes affect every delete confirmation in the app.

views.title: Sidebar – Recent workspaces loading skeleton
views.reach: Reload any shell route; visible while listGadgets() is pending (throttle network to hold).
views.styling: Four `h-7 rounded-md bg-kumo-elevated animate-pulse` bars. Note: same token as the rail background (`bg-kumo-elevated`), so the skeleton is nearly invisible.
views.notes: Only the Recent section shows a skeleton; Favorites shows its empty copy while loading.

views.title: Sidebar – workspace row (incl. inline rename)
views.reach: Any row under Favorites / Recent workspaces (needs at least one workspace). Choose Rename from the row's ... menu to see the inline rename input.
views.styling: Row `h-8 rounded-lg pl-1.5 pr-1 text-[13px] tracking-[-0.25px] hover:bg-kumo-tint`; active via activeProps `bg-kumo-fill text-kumo-strong font-medium`; monogram `h-6 w-6 rounded-md bg-kumo-fill text-[10px] text-kumo-subtle`; rename input `bg-transparent border-b border-kumo-brand`. Kebab trigger `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`.
views.notes: Collapsed rail shows monogram only (with sr-only title).

views.title: Sidebar – workspace actions menu
views.reach: Hover a workspace row in the rail and click the ... button (Rename, Favorite/Unfavorite, Share, Delete/Dismiss).
components: Phosphor: DotsThree, Pencil, Star, ShareNetwork, Trash
views.styling: Shared menuStyles constants: MENU_CONTENT (`themed-floating-shadow !z-[1100] !min-w-[180px] rounded-lg border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-1`), MENU_ITEM (`text-[13px] data-highlighted:bg-kumo-tint`), MENU_ITEM_DANGER (`data-highlighted:bg-kumo-danger-tint`, Kumo variant="danger"). `.themed-floating-shadow` in styles.css is a hard-coded rgba(20,18,35,0.1) shadow with a dark-mode override.
views.notes: 'Dismiss' instead of 'Delete' for workspaces shared with you (gadget.owner set). Positioner z-index 1100 via MENU_POSITIONER_STYLE.

views.title: Sidebar – share workspace modal
views.reach: Workspace row ... menu > Share.
views.styling: Styled inside ShareModal (shared with the workspace editor); not restyled here.
views.notes: Same modal the workspace editor opens; another slice may own its internals.

views.title: Build | Operate mode toggle
views.reach: Any shell route with the `operate-mode` UI flag on (dev default) and canvasFeatures.composableViews enabled; sits under the rail's brand row. 'Operate' navigates to /inferops-canvas; 'Build' returns to the last Build location of this session (in memory; '/' after a reload).
views.styling: Segmented control `flex shrink-0 gap-0.5 rounded-lg bg-kumo-base p-[3px]` (`mx-2 mt-1` expanded; `mx-auto mt-2 flex-col` collapsed). Buttons `h-7 rounded-md text-[13px]` (`flex-1` expanded, `w-7` icon-only collapsed); pressed `bg-kumo-control font-medium text-kumo-default`, idle `text-kumo-subtle hover:text-kumo-default`; focus `ring-2 ring-kumo-ring`.
views.notes: Mode is derived from the URL (modeForPath): /inferops-canvas and /workspace/<id>/inferops-canvas are Operate, everything else Build. Buttons carry aria-pressed. With the toggle shown, the nav's 'InferOps Canvas' item is hidden. On /inferops-canvas itself the rail is not rendered (see operate.shell), so the toggle is mostly seen in Build and on a workspace's InferOps Canvas page.

views.title: Standalone (no shell) layout
views.reach: Open /signup or /connect/handoff (no header), or /blueprint/<id> while signed out (with Header).
views.styling: `flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col`; `<main class="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">`.
views.notes: Signed-in users on /blueprint/$id get the full shell instead.

views.title: Public top header
views.reach: Sign out (or use a private window) and open /blueprint/<id>.
components: local: SiteLogo, TopBarNotice, UserMenu (only if authenticated)
views.styling: `app-header sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-kumo-line`, inline style `backgroundColor: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-kumo-base) 80%, transparent)`. Nav links use string class constants (`text-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-kumo-subtle`, active `text-kumo-default bg-kumo-tint`). styles.css drops `.app-header` to z-index 0 while any dialog is open.
views.notes: Legacy header: in practice only reached on the signed-out blueprint page, so links to Gatekeepers/Explore lead to login. Desktop nav hidden below `sm`.

views.title: Public header – mobile menu
views.reach: Signed out, open /blueprint/<id> at width < 640px and tap the hamburger in the header.
views.styling: `sm:hidden border-t border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base`, vertical nav `px-4 py-3 gap-1`; Sign out `text-kumo-danger`.
views.notes: Hamburger button has no aria-label. Profile/Providers/Admin/Sign out rows appear only when authenticated (not normally the case here).

views.title: Root render states
views.reach: Group entry for the non-shell branches of RootComponent/AuthenticatedShell in __root.tsx.
views.styling: All states are centered flex columns on `bg-kumo-base` with Tailwind utility classes; spinner is a `border-2 border-kumo-brand border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin` div.
views.notes: Signed-out non-public routes render LoginPage and onboarding renders OnboardingWizard (auth/onboarding slice, not mapped here).

views.title: Authentication error
views.reach: Occurs when useAuth returns an error (e.g. a bad/expired stored authToken the backend rejects). No URL toggle; force by editing localStorage `authToken` to an invalid value and reloading if the backend errors on it.
views.styling: Centered column with `p-6`; message `text-sm text-kumo-danger`; Retry is a raw <button> `px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-kumo-inverse bg-kumo-brand rounded-lg hover:bg-kumo-brand-hover` (not a Kumo Button).
views.notes: Hard to reproduce on demand; the exact trigger depends on useAuth.

views.title: Authenticating (Cloudflare Access mode)
views.reach: Only in builds with CF_ACCESS_MODE enabled (Access-mode frontend build); shown while pipelined auth resolves.
views.styling: Same spinner layout as loading, caption 'Authenticating...'.
views.notes: Visually identical to shell.state.loading apart from the caption.

views.title: Fatal render error fallback
views.reach: Any uncaught React render error anywhere in the app (wraps the whole tree in main.tsx). Reproduce by throwing in a component during render in dev.
views.styling: `<main class="mx-auto flex min-h-full max-w-lg flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 px-6 text-center">`; h1 `text-xl font-semibold` (no colour token); Reload button `rounded-md bg-kumo-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm` with no text-colour token or hover state.
views.notes: Renders outside ThemeProvider/ServerConfig, so it gets only global styles.css; the button text colour is inherited, which may be low-contrast on brand in some themes.

views.title: Loading / waiting for server
views.reach: Hard-reload any non-standalone route; visible while useAuth resolves. Text becomes 'Waiting for server…' if the RPC connection is lost (stop the dev server and reload).
views.styling: `flex min-h-full items-center justify-center flex-col gap-4 bg-kumo-base`; 8x8 brand spinner; `text-sm text-kumo-subtle` caption.
views.notes: Brief in practice; throttle network or stop the backend to hold it.

views.title: Checking onboarding (bare spinner)
views.reach: Signed in, immediately after auth while isOnboardingCompleted() is pending.
views.styling: Spinner only, no caption, `bg-kumo-base`.
views.notes: Flashes briefly; leads to either OnboardingWizard (other slice) or the shell.

views.title: Shell top bar
views.reach: Any shell route (e.g. /). On mobile (< md) it carries the hamburger.
views.styling: `relative flex h-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-between bg-kumo-base px-3` (no bottom border); height matches the rail's brand row so they read as one strip. Hamburger `h-11 w-11 md:hidden hover:bg-kumo-tint`.
views.notes: Mostly empty on desktop unless a notice or reconnecting chip shows. Not rendered on /inferops-canvas in Operate mode, where AppShell stacks TopBarNotice and ReconnectingChip directly above the console frame.

views.title: Top bar notice (admin announcement)
views.reach: As admin set the top-bar notice/announcement in /admin; visible at width >= lg (1024px) in the shell top bar, the public Header, the workspace editor and gadget use view top bars.
views.styling: Absolutely centered overlay `hidden lg:flex absolute inset-0 items-center justify-center pointer-events-none px-40`; text `text-[13px] leading-[18px] tracking-[-0.25px] text-kumo-subtle truncate`; links `text-kumo-brand hover:underline pointer-events-auto`.
views.notes: Hidden below lg. Parent container must be position: relative.

views.title: Reconnecting chip
views.reach: While signed in on a shell route, stop the dev server (or drop the WebSocket); the chip appears at the top bar's right. Also shown in the workspace editor top bar.
views.styling: `text-xs text-kumo-warning px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-kumo-warning-tint border border-kumo-warning/20`.
views.notes: Deliberately an inline pill, not a banner, to avoid layout reflow. In the Operate console frame (operate.shell) it renders above the page rather than in a top bar.

views.title: Home (new workspace launcher)
views.reach: Signed in, open /. Use /?prompt=<text> to pre-seed the composer (prompt is trimmed, length-capped by MAX_GATEKEEPER_APP_PROMPT_LENGTH; the param is then stripped from the URL).
components: local: MeshBackground, WorkspaceKindPicker, ChatComposer, HomeTaskSuggestions, FlaggedChatLayout
views.styling: `relative isolate flex min-h-full w-full flex-col items-center justify-start px-4 pb-16 pt-10 sm:px-8 sm:pt-16 lg:pt-24`; inner column `max-w-2xl gap-8`.
flags: UI feature flags 'chat-layout-dashboard' | 'chat-layout-thread' | 'chat-layout-copilot' swap the default launcher for a flagged layout (useChatLayout; first in that order wins)
UI feature flag 'operate-mode' adds the workspace kind picker
views.notes: Error toasts: 'Couldn't load AI models' (non-connection listModels failure) and 'Failed to create workspace' on send failure, via Kumo Toasty. The composer and suggestions are built once and handed to whichever layout renders; with a chat-layout-* flag on, FlaggedChatLayout replaces the hero/mesh/kind-picker column (see home.layout-*).

views.title: Home – prompt composer
views.reach: Center of /. Pre-fill with /?prompt=... or by clicking a 'Get started' suggestion.
views.styling: Styled by the chat slice's ChatComposer + its CSS module; Home only passes props.
views.notes: Composer internals (model picker, + menu, attachments) belong to the chat slice. Draft persisted per user under composerDraftStorageKey(userId, 'home'). The same element is placed by the flagged layouts: floating dock (dashboard), under the thread (thread), or in the Agent panel (copilot). With a non-default workspace kind picked, send also calls overseer.setKind in the same batch.

views.title: Home – hero and mesh backdrop
views.reach: Top of /.
views.styling: h1 `text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-kumo-default`; subcopy `text-[14px] leading-5 tracking-[-0.25px] text-kumo-subtle max-w-md`. Backdrop container `absolute inset-x-0 top-0 -z-10 h-[460px]` with inline linear-gradient maskImage/WebkitMaskImage. MeshBackground draws a static perspective hex grid on canvas with hard-coded stroke rgba(120,118,113,a) (not theme-aware).
views.notes: Mesh colour is fixed grey in JS, so it does not change with dark mode or accent colour; redraws on resize via ResizeObserver. Only in the default layout: not rendered when a chat-layout-* flag selects a flagged layout.

views.title: Home – 'Get started' task suggestions
views.reach: Below the composer on /. Three of five suggestions, randomly chosen per mount (reload to reshuffle). Clicking one seeds the composer text without sending.
components: Phosphor: FileText, Presentation, ChartLineUp, Lightning, AppWindow
views.styling: Heading `text-[12px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.06em] text-kumo-inactive`; rows `.press rounded-xl px-2 py-2 hover:bg-kumo-tint`; icon tile `h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-kumo-fill text-kumo-subtle`; label `text-[13px] font-medium`, description `text-[12px] text-kumo-subtle`, both truncated.
views.notes: Random order means screenshots differ between loads. Flagged layouts move it: above the composer in the thread layout, inside the Agent panel in the copilot layout, and omitted in the dashboard layout.

views.title: Home – workspace kind picker
views.reach: Signed in, open / with the 'operate-mode' UI flag on (on by default in local dev, where DEV_UI_FEATURE_FLAGS has operate-mode dev:true; Flagship elsewhere). Sits between the hero and the composer in the default layout.
views.styling: Kumo card radios stacked on mobile, three columns from sm via `sm:[&>div]:grid sm:[&>div]:grid-cols-3`; label `inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px]` with 15px icon; description `text-[12px] leading-4`.
views.notes: Kinds App / Widget / Workflow, default App. A non-default choice is sent as overseer.setKind(kind) in the same batch as the first newChat, so the first agent turn already builds that kind. Legend 'What this workspace builds' is screen-reader only. Not rendered in the flagged chat layouts.

views.title: Home – Dashboard chat layout (A)
views.reach: UI feature flag 'chat-layout-dashboard' must be on for the signed-in user, then open /. Production resolves it per user through the Flagship FLAGS binding; local dev (env.DEV) uses DEV_UI_FEATURE_FLAGS where every chat-layout-* flag is dev:false, so set `dev: true` for 'chat-layout-dashboard' in packages/workshop-shared/src/feature-flags.ts to see it locally.
components: local: FlaggedChatLayout, MetricSlot, ChatComposer (passed in as the composer slot)
views.styling: Root `relative flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col`; scroller `px-4 pb-64 pt-6 sm:px-8` (bottom padding clears the floating composer); header h1 `text-lg font-semibold`, subcopy `text-xs text-kumo-subtle`; grids: 4 stats `grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4`, chart+list `lg:grid-cols-3` (chart spans 2), three-up `md:grid-cols-3`.
flags: wins over chat-layout-thread/copilot when several are on (resolveChatLayout precedence)
views.notes: Header 'Overview' / 'Widgets fill in as data sources are connected.' Replaces the hero, mesh, kind picker and task suggestions entirely (the suggestions slot is not rendered). MetricSlot placeholders only: no metrics source exists, every slot reads 'No data source connected yet'.

views.title: Dashboard layout – floating composer dock
views.reach: Bottom of / with the chat-layout-dashboard layout active.
components: local: ChatComposer (same props as the default Home composer)
views.styling: `pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex justify-center px-4 pb-4`; panel `themed-floating-shadow-lg pointer-events-auto w-full max-w-3xl rounded-2xl bg-kumo-overlay p-2`.
views.notes: Floats over the metrics grid; the grid's pb-64 keeps the last row scrollable above it.

views.title: Home layouts – metric placeholder slot
views.reach: Any flagged Home layout (chat-layout-dashboard, -thread or -copilot); every widget tile is one.
views.styling: `flex h-full flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl bg-kumo-elevated p-4` with min-h-24 (stat) or min-h-56 (chart/list); h2 `text-sm font-semibold`; body `rounded-lg border border-dashed border-kumo-line px-3 py-4 text-xs text-kumo-subtle` with a 16px text-kumo-inactive icon.
views.notes: Parented to the dashboard layout but shared by all three. Each slot is a <section aria-label='<title>'> (e.g. 'Agent runs'), so a specific tile is findable by its title. Deliberately shows no numbers until a metrics source exists.

views.title: Home – Thread chat layout (B)

views.title: Root auth gate

views.title: Auth loading screen

views.title: Sign-in: deployment settings failed

views.title: Sign-in: error banner

views.reach: Edit a file in the diff view while the OT client cannot flush (e.g. backend/WebSocket down); onDirtyState sets hasUnsavedChanges and the strip appears at the top of the code view.
views.styling: Tailwind 'bg-kumo-tint border-b border-kumo-line px-4 py-2 text-sm text-kumo-warning'; uses a literal warning emoji (U+26A0 U+FE0F) as its icon.
views.notes: Text: 'Connection issue - changes will be saved when connection is restored'. Inconsistent with Kumo Banner used elsewhere.

views.title: Diff editor (in-chat changes, stacked layout)
views.reach: Select a conversation (?chat=<id>), open the Code tab, click a file (ideally a changed one from the Changes list). Stacked layout is the default when the pane is narrower than 1100px or the stored preference is 'stacked'.
components: CodeMirror 6: EditorView with codeEditorTheme + diffRenderExtension (line/mark decorations, block widgets for deletion zones, change-bar gutter, line-number gutter markers)
local: layout toggle buttons (native <button>), +/- summary pill
views.styling: Base chrome from codeTheme.ts (hard-coded hex). Diff layer in CodeDiffEditor.css, scoped to .gadgets-diff-surface with CSS custom properties --gd-* (light in :where(.gadgets-diff-surface), dark under [data-mode="dark"] .gadgets-diff-surface): --gd-add-bg #f1f8eb, --gd-del-bg #fcebe6, --gd-add-bar #5fa940, --gd-mod-bar #d6a400, --gd-del-bar #d6433a, etc. Classes: .gadgets-diff-line-add/-delete (mix-blend-mode multiply in light), .gadgets-diff-gutter-bar (3px), .gadgets-diff-inline-add/-delete (char highlights), .gadgets-deleted-code-zone/-row/-num-row/-omitted-row (deletion zone widgets + 'expand' button). Surface wrapper Tailwind: md:m-4 md:rounded-[10px] md:border md:border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base, inline style isolation:isolate. Overlay toolbar at right-3 top-3 (inline zIndex 1): layout toggle group and a mono pill with text-kumo-danger '-N' / text-kumo-success '+N' and status (e.g. Added/Deleted).
views.selector: .gadgets-diff-surface; button[aria-label="Use stacked diff layout"], button[aria-label="Use split diff layout"]
views.notes: Editable (bound to the chat's OT session) unless locked (agent active, client not ready) or file exceeds MAX_FILE_TEXT_LENGTH. Shows 'Select a file to view changes' / 'Loading diff...' placeholder before editors mount. Layout preference persisted in localStorage key 'gadgets:workshop:diffLayout'.

views.title: Diff editor: split (side-by-side) layout
views.reach: In the diff view, make the code pane at least 1100px wide (SPLIT_DIFF_MIN_WIDTH) and click the Columns toggle (or localStorage 'gadgets:workshop:diffLayout' = 'split', the default). Below 1100px the split button is disabled ('Split diff needs more space').
components: CodeMirror: second read-only EditorView for the original, scroll-synced
views.styling: Hatched alignment filler: .gadgets-diff-blank-zone / .gadgets-diff-blank-margin (repeating-linear-gradient on --gd-blank-bg). Divider 'w-px bg-kumo-line'. Both panes are '.cm-editor-host' with inline monoFont.
views.notes: In stacked mode deletions render inline as .gadgets-deleted-code-zone widgets instead.

views.title: Code editor (CodeMirror, read-only head view)
views.reach: Code tab with NO conversation selected (no ?chat), click a file. Shows the committed head read-only. Also used for unreadable files (see workspace.code.editor.unreadable).
components: CodeMirror 6: EditorView/EditorState, lineNumbers, foldGutter, highlightSpecialChars, drawSelection, bracketMatching, highlightSelectionMatches, search keymap (search panel), lineWrapping
CodeMirror theme: codeEditorTheme(mode) from codeTheme.ts (EditorView.theme chrome + HighlightStyle)
views.styling: ALL editor colors are hard-coded hex in codeTheme.ts, not Kumo tokens: editorChrome() (EditorView.theme) sets bg/fg/gutter/selection/searchMatch/panels/fold placeholder, font 13px / line-height 20px / gutter 12px, padding; palettes chromeLight (bg #fffdfb, fg #1f1d1a, gutter #cabfb2, selection #b3d4ff, panelBg #faf6f1) and chromeDark (bg #16151f, fg #e8e6f0, selection #4b3d66, panelBg #1d1c29). Syntax colors in highlightLight/highlightDark HighlightStyle.define (e.g. keyword #8e3aa6/#d8b4fe, string #4d8a44/#86efac, function #3a72c9/#93c5fd). Theme swaps via a Compartment on resolvedThemeMode. Host div 'cm-editor-host h-full overflow-hidden' with inline fontFamily monoFont. Palette said to match gatekeeper-context's CodeMirror theme (separate package).
views.notes: Editable mode (session-bound) exists in the component but WorkpieceCodeInterface only renders CodeEditor read-only; in-chat editing goes through CodeDiffEditor. Without a filename it renders 'Select a file to start editing' (bg-kumo-base text-kumo-subtle).

views.title: Unreadable file notice (binary / symlink / oversized)
views.reach: Code tab: open a file whose base entry is unreadable (binary, symlink or over the size cap). The reason text is shown read-only in a CodeEditor.
views.styling: Same codeTheme.ts styling as the editor; no distinct styling.
views.notes: Visually identical to the editor; listed because content and reach differ.

views.title: No files yet (empty workpiece)
views.reach: Code tab for a workpiece with no files. With a chat selected the copy invites building with the agent and shows a primary 'New file' button; without a chat the copy says accepted files will appear.
views.styling: Tailwind: centered max-w-[360px]; title text-[15px] leading-[22px] font-semibold tracking-[-0.3px] text-kumo-default; body text-[13px] leading-[19px] text-kumo-subtle.
views.notes: Rendered in the editor pane; the file browser still shows alongside.

views.title: Code load error states
views.reach: Whole view: tree read fails -> "Failed to load this <workpiece>'s code." + 'Try again'; chat OT client fatal error -> "Failed to load this conversation's code changes. Try reloading the page." Per file: file/base read fails -> 'Failed to load this file.' + 'Try again' in the editor pane. Requires a failing backend RPC to reproduce.
views.styling: Tailwind: text-sm text-kumo-danger, centered column with gap-3.
views.notes: Three variants share the same look.

views.title: Code file browser (Files tree / Changes list)
views.reach: Open /workspace/<id>, select a gadget or worktree, click the right-pane 'Code' tab (tab is local React state in GadgetEditor, not a search param; worktrees default to Code). Desktop (>=md): fixed 260px column on the left of the code view.
components: Phosphor: FolderSimple, File, TerminalWindow, Plus, X, Pencil, Trash, DownloadSimple
views.styling: Tailwind + Kumo tokens (bg-kumo-base, border-kumo-line, hover:bg-kumo-tint, text-kumo-inactive, bg-kumo-recessed for active row). Row indent via inline style paddingLeft (ROW_BASE_PADDING_PX + depth*INDENT_PX). Active row uses global .file-row-active (styles.css: inset 3px brand bar + color-mix ring). Status dot: bg-kumo-success (added) / bg-kumo-danger (deleted) / bg-kumo-warning (modified); deleted rows line-through; agent-editing dot bg-kumo-success. Rows h-10 mobile / md:h-7. Section header uses SECTION_HEADER_CLASS constant in FileBrowser.tsx.
views.notes: Header reads 'Files' or 'Changes (N)'. When in a chat (branchMode / isDiffMode) and the chat has changes, a flat Changes list renders above a second 'Files' section header and the tree. New file button disabled with title=lockedHint when editing is locked (no chat selected, agent active, or OT client not ready). Root has no stable test id; outer div is 'flex h-full w-[260px] flex-col border-r'.

views.title: File browser: Changes section (in-chat diff mode)
views.reach: In the Code tab, select a conversation (?chat=<id>) in which the agent or you changed files. The Changes list appears above the tree with status dots and dimmed directory prefixes.
views.styling: Same row styling as tree; dirPrefix span text-kumo-inactive; status dot colors from statusDotClass (bg-kumo-success/danger/warning); deleted = line-through; pending rows have no menu.
views.notes: showChanges = isDiffMode && changes.length > 0. A changed file appears both here and in the tree.

views.title: Delete file confirmation
views.reach: Code tab inside an unlocked chat: row menu > Delete.
views.styling: Shared app-wide delete dialog; description path in font-mono text-kumo-default.
views.notes: DeleteConfirmationDialog is a shared component; other agents may also list it for other contexts.

views.title: New file dialog
views.reach: Code tab inside an unlocked chat: click '+' (aria-label 'New file') in the file browser header, or the 'New file' button in the 'No files yet' empty state (calls FileBrowserHandle.openCreateModal).
components: Kumo: Dialog.Root, Dialog, Dialog.Title, Dialog.Description, Dialog.Close
views.styling: Dialog className 'responsive-dialog !z-[1000] !w-[min(420px,calc(100vw-32px))] overflow-hidden bg-kumo-base p-0 !top-[18%] !-translate-y-0' (responsive-dialog defined in styles.css). Header/footer border-kumo-line; title text-[15px] tracking-[-0.3px]; filename input font-mono.
views.notes: Validation errors surface as toasts (see workspace.code.toasts).

views.title: Inline file rename row
views.reach: Code tab inside an unlocked chat: row menu > Rename.
views.styling: Row bg-kumo-base ring-1 ring-kumo-ring/40; input bg-transparent text-[16px] (md:text-[13px]) placeholder:text-kumo-inactive.
views.notes: Enter submits, Escape cancels (IME-aware).

views.title: File row actions menu (Download / Rename / Delete)
views.reach: Code tab: hover a file row (desktop; trigger is opacity-0 until hover/focus) or tap on mobile, click the '...' trigger. Rename/Delete only appear when editing is not locked (inside a selected chat, agent idle).
views.styling: Content: themed-floating-shadow (styles.css, dark variant under [data-mode=dark]) + '!z-[1100] !min-w-[144px] rounded-lg border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-1'. Items '!h-auto rounded-md !px-2.5 !py-1.5 text-[12px]', data-highlighted:bg-kumo-tint; Delete item data-highlighted:bg-kumo-danger-tint. Heavy use of ! important overrides on Kumo.
views.notes: Hidden for deleted, pending, renaming, or non-openable rows. Rename switches the row to an inline input (aria-label 'Rename <path>', ring-1 ring-kumo-ring/40).

views.title: Mobile file drawer (Files dialog)
views.reach: Viewport < md (768px): open the Code pane, tap the list icon (aria-label 'Open files') in the file header bar. Drawer slides in from the left over a black/25 scrim.
views.styling: Tailwind max-md: utilities: absolute inset-y-0 left-0 z-30 w-[min(85vw,320px)] shadow-xl transition-transform translate-x-0/-translate-x-full; scrim 'absolute inset-0 z-20 bg-black/25 md:hidden' (hard-coded black). FileBrowser gets className 'max-md:!w-full'.
views.selector: [role=dialog][aria-label="Files"] (only in compact layout); open: button[aria-label="Open files"]; close: button[aria-label="Close files"]
views.notes: On desktop the same wrapper is a plain flex column with no role.

views.title: Open-file header bar (mode label, HEAD badge, download)
views.reach: Code tab with a file selected. Label reads 'Viewing <file>' (no chat), 'Editing changes in <file>' (chat, unlocked) or 'Reviewing changes in <file>' (chat, locked). HEAD badge only for worktree workpieces.
views.styling: Tailwind: h-11 md:h-9 border-b border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base px-2 md:px-3; label text-[13px] md:text-[12px] text-kumo-subtle with font-mono filename; HEAD badge rounded bg-kumo-tint font-mono text-[11px].
views.notes: With no file selected the bar shows only on mobile ('Files' label + drawer trigger).

views.title: Code loading states
views.reach: Briefly visible on opening the Code tab ('Loading code files...'), on opening a file before its content arrives ('Loading file...'), and in CodeDiffEditor before editors mount ('Loading diff...'). Throttle the network/WebSocket to hold them.
views.styling: Tailwind flex-centered text-kumo-subtle (diff variant text-[13px] leading-[18px] tracking-[-0.25px]); heights via inline style height prop.
views.notes: Plain text, no spinner/skeleton.

views.title: Editing locked banner
views.reach: Code tab with files present and NO conversation selected: banner 'Select or start a conversation to edit' above the editor.
views.styling: Kumo Banner with className 'm-2 w-auto shrink-0'.
views.notes: lockedHint is only set outside a chat; agent-active locking does not show this banner (it only disables controls).

views.title: Code file operation toasts
views.reach: Create/rename/delete/download files in the Code tab (success: 'Created file: x', 'Deleted file: x', 'Renamed file: a -> b'; errors: 'File already exists', 'Filename cannot be empty', 'Invalid file path', 'Cannot delete the last remaining file', 'Could not download x'); warning when local edits are discarded by a concurrent revert.
views.styling: Kumo toast styling; nothing local.
views.notes: Toast container itself is app-level (not in this slice).

views.title: Workspace Connections tab (gadget bindings)
views.reach: Open a workspace at /workspace/$id with a gadget selected, then pick the right-pane 'Connections' tab (on mobile: the pane dropdown menu -> 'Connections'). Not shown for worktree workpieces or use-only collaborators. Tab state is not in the URL.
components: local: GatekeeperIcon, HookToggle, WorkshopButton, WorkshopIconButton, WorkshopInput, EmptyState, GatekeeperModal, BlueprintAnnotationModal (private)
Phosphor: Pencil, Trash, Blueprint, Warning, X
views.styling: `h-full overflow-auto bg-kumo-base`, inner `max-w-5xl px-4 py-5 sm:px-6`. h2 17px medium. List container `rounded-xl border border-kumo-line` with border-t row dividers.
views.notes: Connections.tsx is NOT part of /gatekeepers despite the name; it is the per-gadget bindings tab. Id uses the workspace.* namespace to match other slices.

views.title: Connected resource (binding) row
views.reach: Connections tab after connecting a resource (e.g. 'Connect resource' -> InferOps 'Project board' with the mock InferOps account, or 'AI Model').
views.styling: Row `px-3 py-3`; title 13px medium; 'Referenced in code as:' 11px text-kumo-inactive with font-mono binding name. 'Draft' pill `rounded-full bg-kumo-fill px-1.5 text-[10px]` when the binding is provisional to the open chat. GatekeeperIcon applies inline vendor color behind logos.
views.selector: button[aria-label='Edit name used in code'], [aria-label='Edit blueprint settings'], [aria-label='Delete connection']
views.notes: Draft state: connect with a chat open (?chat=<id>); the blueprint-settings button is hidden for drafts.

views.title: Binding / hook delete confirmation (inline)
views.reach: Connections tab -> trash 'Delete connection' (or 'Delete hook') on a row.
views.styling: Row tinted `bg-kumo-danger-tint/40`; title text-kumo-danger.

views.title: Binding rename (inline edit)
views.reach: Connections tab -> pencil 'Edit name used in code' on a binding row.
views.styling: Input flex-1 font-mono; Save button `!h-8`.

views.title: Blueprint settings dialog (binding annotation)
views.reach: Connections tab -> Blueprint icon 'Edit blueprint settings' on a non-draft binding row.
views.styling: Dialog lg with overrides `responsive-dialog !z-[1000] !w-[min(480px,calc(100vw-32px))]`. Save-error callout has left border accent `border-l-2 border-l-kumo-brand` with Warning icon.

views.title: No connected resources
views.reach: Connections tab of a gadget with no bindings (any new workspace).
views.styling: Shared EmptyState.
views.notes: A 'Loading connections...' bordered box precedes it while loading.

views.title: Hooks section

components: local: GatekeeperIcon, HookToggle (Kumo Switch size sm in Tooltip), WorkshopIconButton 'Delete hook'
views.styling: Section mt-8; same bordered list styling as bindings.

views.title: Loading conversation overlay
views.reach: Briefly on first load until chat count and code state are known (layoutModeReady false).
views.styling: Absolute overlay bg-kumo-base with 6x6 brand spinner and "Loading conversation…" text-sm text-kumo-subtle; the chat underneath is `invisible`.
views.notes: Covers only the chat column.

views.title: Delete workspace confirmation
views.reach: As owner, click the trash icon (aria-label "Delete workspace") or mobile More > Delete workspace.
views.styling: `responsive-dialog !z-[1000] !w-[min(420px,calc(100vw-32px))] !top-[20%]`, size sm; header/footer separated by border-kumo-line; danger button `bg-kumo-danger text-white` (hard-coded white in WorkshopControls).
views.notes: Dismissal blocked while deleting ("Deleting..."). Shared component also used elsewhere.

views.title: Export gadget menu
views.reach: Desktop: download icon in the pane header (gadget selected). Mobile: download icon in the top bar. Also in the use-only top bar.
views.styling: Content `themed-floating-shadow !z-[1100] !min-w-[144px] rounded-lg border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-1`; items text-[12px] data-highlighted:bg-kumo-tint.
views.notes: States: loading skeleton ([role="status"][aria-label="Loading export formats"]), load failed + "Try again", empty ("This Gadget does not support exports."), format list, exporting (brand progress bar under the icon). Renders nothing with no gadget.

views.reach: Visit /gadget/<id>; it redirects (replace) to /workspace/<id>, keeping search (?chat=, ?w=) and hash (#share=, #fullscreen).

views.title: Loading workspace
views.reach: Shown until metadata, overseer, the workpiece list and the selected gadget stub are all ready. Throttle the network or reload /workspace/<id>.
views.styling: Centered `w-8 h-8 border-2 border-kumo-brand border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin` + text-kumo-subtle "Loading workspace…".
views.notes: Full-page; the ObserverConfigModal may render on top of it.

views.title: Workspace error message
views.reach: useWorkspaceOpen reports error.kind === 'message' (e.g. observer-verification denial). Hard to trigger locally without a restricted shared workspace.

views.styling: Centered column; message `text-sm text-kumo-danger whitespace-pre-line text-center max-w-lg`.
views.notes: Multi-line messages preserved (one line per failed connection).

views.title: Mobile view tab bar
views.reach: Viewport < 768px (md). Bar under the top bar with Chat / Preview (Code for a worktree, Triggers for a Workflow-kind workspace) / Activity / More.
views.styling: h-12 border-b border-kumo-line; buttons h-9 rounded-lg text-[14px]; active `bg-kumo-tint text-kumo-default`, inactive text-kumo-subtle; pending dot `bg-kumo-brand`.
views.notes: md:hidden. Chat closes the pane; Preview/Code/Triggers opens it.

views.title: Mobile "More" menu
views.reach: On mobile, tap the ⋯ button in the tab bar.
views.styling: MENU_CONTENT / MENU_ITEM / MENU_ITEM_DANGER classes and MENU_POSITIONER_STYLE from components/menuStyles.ts.
views.notes: Items: Code, Connections, workpiece list (when >1), Rename, Share, Blueprints, Full-screen preview (only when the output view is the app, i.e. not a Workflow-kind workspace; enabled only while preview active), Delete.

views.title: Verify connections (observer config)
views.reach: Open a shared workspace whose connections require the recipient to pick/verify their own accounts (server calls ObserverConfigCallback.configure during open). Renders over the loading state.
views.styling: Kumo Dialog with `responsive-dialog` (bottom sheet under 768px / short windows, styles.css), size lg, top clamp(24px,10vh,80px).

views.title: Workspace open error page
views.reach: Open /workspace/<bad-id> (not-found), a workspace you lack access to (access-denied), or a share link on a workspace with share links disabled; other failures show the generic variant.
views.styling: Tailwind + Kumo tokens; per-kind title/message/icon from a CONTENT map.
views.notes: Variants: 'access-denied', 'not-found', 'share-links-disabled', and a generic "We couldn't load this workspace" (retryable).

views.title: Outputs rail
views.reach: Workspace with at least one gadget/worktree while the pane is closed (md+). Toggle with the caret button at the top.
views.styling: `border-l border-kumo-line bg-kumo-elevated`, width 48px collapsed / 220px expanded (inline, transition-[width] 200ms). Selected row bg-kumo-fill; draft/agent-editing dots bg-kumo-brand; hook glyph Lightning.
views.notes: Hidden below md. Expanded state persisted in localStorage gadgets:workshop:appRailExpanded. Sections: gadgets, "Worktrees", "View activity".

views.title: Rename output (inline)
views.reach: Expand the rail, hover a gadget row, click the pencil (aria-label "Rename <title>").
views.styling: Input `!h-7 bg-kumo-tint text-[13px]`; 24px icon buttons.
views.notes: Enter saves, Escape cancels.

views.title: Workpiece / activity pane
views.reach: Open a workpiece (click an output in the rail, a created-app card in chat, or use ?w=<id>). Close with the X in the pane header.
components: local: PaneLabel, PaneWorkpieceTabs, PaneTab (private), GadgetUI, WorkpieceCodeInterface, Connections, Activity
views.styling: Inline width calc(100% - chatWidth - 1px) and opacity, animated 200ms; bg-kumo-base. On mobile full width when open.
views.notes: Open/closed and selected app persisted per workspace in localStorage gadgets:workshop:workspaceVisibility:<id>.

views.title: Pane tab bar
views.reach: Visible on md+ whenever the pane is open.
components: local: PaneLabel, PaneWorkpieceTabs, PaneTab + CountBadge, GadgetExportMenu, WorkshopIconButton (Enter full screen, Close)
views.styling: Height 48px inline; border-b border-kumo-line px-3. Segmented control `rounded-lg border border-kumo-line p-0.5`; PaneTab text-[12.5px] active bg-kumo-tint. PaneLabel pill bg-kumo-tint max-w-[180px] with "Draft" badge bg-kumo-fill.
views.selector: button[aria-label="Enter full screen"]; close button aria-label "Close gadget pane" / "Close worktree pane" / "Close activity"
views.notes: Tabs: <format noun> (App/Document/…) | Code | Connections; for a Workflow-kind workspace (operate-mode on) the first tab is 'Triggers'; worktrees show only Code; Activity shows Needs review / Auto-approval / History. The 'Enter full screen' button shows only when the output view is the app (not Workflow, not a worktree). hidden below md.

views.title: Multiple workpiece tabs
views.reach: Workspace with more than one visible workpiece for the selected chat (two gadgets, or a gadget plus a worktree).
views.styling: Horizontal scroller `.hide-scrollbar` (styles.css); active tab max-w-[240px] bg-kumo-tint, others max-w-[150px] text-kumo-subtle; Draft pill.

views.title: Workflow triggers panel
views.reach: With 'operate-mode' on, switch a workspace to Workflow (toolbar kind switch); the pane's first tab becomes 'Triggers' and opens even before any gadget exists. Have an agent bind a hook or scheduled task to list rows.

'Wakes <gadget>' only when the workspace has >1 gadget. Toggle failure toasts 'Failed to enable/disable trigger'. Reloads on listHooks when hooks change.

views.title: App / preview tab
views.reach: Open a gadget and select the first pane tab (labelled by format noun, e.g. "App" or "Document").
views.styling: Wrapper `h-full`; hidden when another tab is active.

views.title: Preview error banner
views.reach: UI bundle load fails/times out, or the iframe RPC handshake fails.
views.styling: Inline padding 20px centering wrapper; Kumo Banner styling.

views.title: Sandboxed gadget iframe
views.reach: Open a gadget that has a UI bundle.

views.title: Fullscreen preview
views.reach: App tab active → click "Enter full screen" (pane header) or mobile More > Full-screen preview; or load /workspace/<id>#fullscreen. Esc or Back exits.

views.title: "Press Esc to exit" hint
views.reach: Enter fullscreen; hint shows for 4 seconds.
views.styling: Top-center pill `rounded-full border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base/90 shadow-md backdrop-blur-sm text-[13px]`; kbd `bg-kumo-elevated`.

views.title: Preview loading
views.reach: While getUiBundle is in flight (first open or after code changes).
views.styling: Inline flex centering styles.
views.notes: Gives up after 20s and shows the error state.

views.title: No gadgets yet placeholder
views.reach: Pane open with no selected gadget stub (e.g. workspace with no gadgets) on the App, Code, or Connections tab; also fills the App view overlay (workspace.app-view) when no gadget is selected.
views.styling: Centered max-w-[360px]; title text-[15px] font-semibold, body text-[13px] text-kumo-subtle; height inline.
views.notes: Shared placeholder for all three tabs and the App view overlay.

views.title: Workspace InferOps Canvas page
views.reach: Open http://localhost:3000/workspace/<id>/inferops-canvas (or the 'InferOps Canvas' button in the workspace editor header, GadgetEditor.tsx) with a build-role workspace. Enable canvas: in-repo `pnpm dev-server`/`pnpm run-local` turns COMPOSABLE_VIEWS+DURABLE_VIEWS on only when an inferos.canvas.json exists at the repo root (scripts/run-dev-server.ts readCanvasConfig), or via a wrapper's inferos.config.json features with --consumer-root. Flags are NOT in FeatureFlagsContext (that is UiFeatureFlags); they come from ServerConfig.canvasFeatures (workshop-backend/src/deployment-config.ts).

Blueprint 'ask agent' requests open a new chat (navigates ?chat=) and switch mobile pane to chat; error toast 'Choose a model in the chat first...' if no stored model; invalid share link toast via useKumoToastManager. Choosing a view clears ?widget; opening a widget pushes history, closing replaces. Passes codingDispatch and wikiEditable to the pane (this is the only surface that offers coding dispatch and Wiki edits).

components: Kumo: Dialog (Root, Trigger, Title/Description sr-only, Close)
views.styling: Kumo Dialog forced into a left drawer with `!` overrides: `!fixed !inset-y-0 !left-0 !m-0 !h-dvh !max-h-dvh !w-80 !translate-x-0 !translate-y-0 rounded-none p-0`; close button `absolute right-2 top-2`.
views.notes: Closes on any sidebar navigation.

views.title: Operate page header
views.reach: With the `operate-mode` UI flag on (DEV_UI_FEATURE_FLAGS turns it on in local dev) and canvasFeatures.composableViews enabled (see canvas.home for how), open http://localhost:8787/inferops-canvas, or click 'Operate' in the rail's Build | Operate toggle. Hidden while console setup or settings is open.
views.styling: `flex min-h-14 shrink-0 flex-wrap items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3`; h1 `flex-1 truncate text-sm font-medium text-kumo-default`; agent note in `hidden max-w-[30%] md:block`.
views.notes: Title follows state: flow title, 'Screens and flows', console view title, 'Assistant' (centered chat), focused screen title, else 'Consoles'. Home shows 'Screens and flows' (ghost) and primary 'New console'; tools shows 'All consoles'; an open console shows 'Console settings' (icon) and 'Show/Hide assistant' (aria-pressed).

views.title: Agent activity note
views.reach: Let the operate agent change the page (e.g. ask the operate chat to open a screen); the header then says 'Agent <did what> · <time>'. Visible at width >= md.
views.styling: `flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5 truncate text-[12px] text-kumo-subtle`; time `text-kumo-inactive`.
views.notes: role=status aria-live=polite; empty until the session log has an agent-authored event.

views.title: Session approvals strip
views.reach: Have the operate chat (or a board card on the focused screen) propose an action that needs approval; the strip appears under the header. After deciding, it shows the outcome ('Recent activity').
components: local: CountBadge, ResolveButton, ActionFields, IncompleteDescriptionNotice, RestrictedApprovalNotice
views.styling: `flex-shrink-0 border-b border-kumo-line px-4 py-2.5`; heading `text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.06em] text-kumo-inactive` ('Needs your approval' / 'Recent activity'); list `max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto`, rows `border-t border-kumo-line py-2`, title `text-[13px] font-medium`, meta `text-[11.5px] text-kumo-inactive`; outcome `text-[12.5px]` applied default / rejected subtle / failed danger.
views.notes: Renders nothing with nothing to decide or report. Clicking a row expands its details (reviewApproval session event). Sources: the session workspace ('Operate chat') and the focused screen's workspace.

views.title: Handover inbox
views.reach: Have another person hand you a board (operate.board.handover-dialog from their session, with your user id). Their handover appears under the header until opened or dismissed.
views.styling: Section `shrink-0 px-5 pb-3`; items `rounded-lg border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-3 text-sm`; Open (primary) / Dismiss (ghost) `size=sm`; failure `text-kumo-danger`.
views.notes: When the board is not reachable for you, the item shows an alert and BoardConnectPrompt to connect it with your own InferOps account.

views.title: Console launcher
views.reach: With the `operate-mode` UI flag on (DEV_UI_FEATURE_FLAGS turns it on in local dev) and canvasFeatures.composableViews enabled (see canvas.home for how), open http://localhost:8787/inferops-canvas, or click 'Operate' in the rail's Build | Operate toggle. With no console open (click 'All consoles').
views.styling: Grid `grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4`; tiles `min-h-40 rounded-xl border bg-kumo-base p-4 hover:border-kumo-ring` (highlighted `border-kumo-ring`, else `border-kumo-line`); icon `text-kumo-subtle`; title `line-clamp-2 text-sm font-medium`; meta `text-xs text-kumo-subtle`; Edit ghost button pinned `!absolute right-2 top-2` (not for use-role).
views.notes: Eight consoles per page. The home layout also shows the operate chat below (operate.chat, 'home' layout).

views.title: No consoles yet
views.reach: Operate home with no saved consoles in any workspace you can open.
views.styling: `rounded-xl border border-dashed border-kumo-line px-6 py-12 text-center`; h2 'Your consoles live here'.

views.title: Consoles loading / failed
views.reach: Reload Operate home; 'Loading consoles…' shows while workspaces' screens load. A load failure shows 'Consoles could not be loaded…'.
views.styling: `py-10 text-sm text-kumo-subtle` (role=status); error `text-kumo-danger` (role=alert).

views.title: Console pages
views.reach: Have more than eight consoles across your workspaces.
views.styling: `flex items-center justify-end gap-3`; Previous/Next `size=sm`; counter `text-xs text-kumo-subtle` aria-live.

views.title: Console saved notice
views.reach: Create or edit a console and save it; back on the launcher a '<title> saved.' line with 'Open console' appears and that tile is highlighted.
views.styling: `mb-4 flex items-center gap-3 text-sm text-kumo-subtle` (role=status).
views.notes: Component state only; gone after a reload.

views.title: Open in this session
views.reach: Open a screen from 'Screens and flows' (operate.tools), then return to All consoles; each open screen gets a button.
views.styling: `mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2` of `size=sm` buttons.
views.notes: Clicking focuses the ref (session 'focus' event).

views.title: Operate chat (Assistant)
views.reach: With the `operate-mode` UI flag on (DEV_UI_FEATURE_FLAGS turns it on in local dev) and canvasFeatures.composableViews enabled (see canvas.home for how), open http://localhost:8787/inferops-canvas, or click 'Operate' in the rail's Build | Operate toggle. It is always mounted; layouts: 'home' (under the launcher), 'side' (docked right when a console view/screen/board shows and chat is open), 'full' (centered 'Assistant' when a console opens in chat presentation), 'hidden' (setup, settings, tools).
components: local: ChatInterface (operateOnly, operateWelcome, operateCenteredStart, operateSuggestions), ConsoleWidgetActions, useResizableSplit
views.styling: Side: `flex min-h-0 shrink-0 flex-col border-l border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base` with inline width from the split (full width below md), header `h-12 border-b px-4` 'Assistant'; resize handle `w-1 cursor-col-resize bg-kumo-line` (hidden below md). Home/full: `mx-auto min-h-[180px] w-full max-w-3xl flex-1 flex-col bg-kumo-base`.
views.notes: One mounted conversation in the person's session workspace moves between layouts. Chat internals belong to the workspace.chat.* views. Shows 'Opening your assistant…' until the session workspace opens. Welcome 'How can I help you today?' in side/full layouts; full layout offers the console's pages as suggestions.

views.title: Open a widget popover
views.reach: Open a console with a view (chat docked at side) and click the squares icon ('Open a widget') in the Assistant header.
views.styling: Content `z-50 max-h-96 w-72 overflow-auto rounded-xl border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-3 shadow-sm`; screen headings `text-xs text-kumo-subtle`; rows `rounded-md hover:bg-kumo-tint` with a ghost label button and an 'Open in a modal' icon button.
views.notes: Empty copy 'Add widgets to a screen in console setup.' Picking opens operate.widget (page) or operate.widget.modal.

views.title: Console view page
views.reach: From the launcher click a console tile (Open <title>) whose start is a view, or pick a page in the console sidebar.
components: local: CanvasView (features/canvas), ConsoleRollup, SessionBoard, BoardConnectPrompt, BackButton/Notice (private)
views.styling: `flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-kumo-base`; breadcrumb row `px-5 pt-3`, crumbs `text-xs text-kumo-subtle` with '›' separators; main `flex-1 overflow-auto focus:outline-none` with inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl p-5`; Back button `text-sm text-kumo-subtle hover:text-kumo-default`.
views.notes: Screens render through the viewer's own workspace capability. Focus moves to main when a board opens or closes.

views.title: Console / view / screen unavailable
views.reach: Open a console whose workspace you lost access to, or whose view/screen was removed elsewhere.
views.styling: Notice `rounded-2xl border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-6 text-sm text-kumo-subtle` (role=alert); loading `text-sm text-kumo-subtle` 'Loading…'.
views.notes: Variants: workspace can't be opened; console removed; view no longer part of the console; screen removed; board can't be shown here (with Back).

views.title: Overview (rollup) view
views.reach: Open a console view of type Overview (created with 'Add Overview' in console setup).
views.styling: Grid `grid-cols-1 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-2`; tiles `rounded-2xl border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-4 hover:shadow-md`; inventory chips `rounded-xl bg-kumo-tint px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm`; unavailable tile `border-dashed text-kumo-subtle`.
views.notes: Selecting a tile shows that screen (showScreen).

views.title: Connect board prompt (use-role)
views.reach: As a use-role operator, open a console whose screen has a board you have not connected in your own session workspace.
views.styling: `space-y-2 text-sm text-kumo-subtle`; one `size=sm` 'Connect with <account>' button per account; link `text-kumo-brand underline`; error `text-kumo-danger`.
views.notes: States: 'Looking for your InferOps account…', no account ('Connect InferOps' link), account buttons. Also used in operate.handovers.

views.title: Session board
views.reach: Open a board card on a console screen, open a handover, or let the agent open a board; the full board replaces the page body (?board=&boardWorkspace=, plus &issue= for an open issue).
views.styling: `flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col gap-2`; from the launcher wrapped in `h-full p-5`. Board internals are styled by the canvas board views.
views.notes: Board and open issue are session state, so other tabs and Back follow. From the launcher, a board opened through a workspace you no longer reach shows an alert with 'Back to consoles'.

views.title: Board presence bar
views.reach: Any open session board. Open the same board from another account to see 'Also here: …'.
views.styling: Row `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2`; roster `flex-1 truncate text-xs text-kumo-subtle` (aria-live); 'Hand over' and 'Audit' (aria-pressed) ghost `size=sm` buttons.
views.notes: Keyed by board so nothing from a previous subject shows.

views.title: Hand over this board
views.reach: Click 'Hand over' in the board presence bar.
views.styling: Kumo Dialog `space-y-4 p-6`; description `text-sm text-kumo-subtle`; form `space-y-3`; error `text-kumo-danger`.
views.notes: Fields: 'Person (their user id)' and 'Note' (max 2000). Success shows 'Handed over to <name>.'

views.title: Board audit
views.reach: Click 'Audit' in the board presence bar.
views.styling: `space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-kumo-line p-3 text-sm`; list `max-h-64 overflow-auto`; time `text-kumo-inactive`; 'Load older' ghost button.
views.notes: Newest first: session events about the board and its workspace's logged reads/actions. Empty: 'Nothing recorded for this board yet.'

views.title: Focused session screen
views.reach: In 'Screens and flows' (operate.tools) click a screen card; it opens into the session as the focused screen.
views.styling: Canvas pane styling comes from the canvas views; loading `p-6 text-sm text-kumo-subtle` 'Loading screen…'.
views.notes: Asking the agent from the pane shows a toast pointing to the operate chat. A focused workspace (not a screen) shows 'Workspaces open in a session come next.'

views.title: Screen unavailable
views.reach: Focus a screen whose workspace you can no longer open, that you only have use access to, or that was removed.
views.styling: Centered column `flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 px-6 text-center`, copy `text-sm text-kumo-subtle`, 'Close it' button.

views.title: Running flow (full canvas)
views.reach: In 'Screens and flows' (operate.tools) create a flow on a workspace with screens and click Start. The flow takes the whole page.
components: Phosphor: ArrowLeftIcon, ArrowRightIcon, ChatCircleIcon, CheckIcon, XIcon
views.styling: `flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden bg-kumo-base`; header `min-h-14 sm:h-14 border-b border-kumo-line px-4` with eyebrow `text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.06em] text-kumo-inactive`, h1 'Step N of M · <title>' `text-[14px] font-medium`, progress pills `h-1.5 w-6 rounded-full` (`bg-kumo-brand` done, `bg-kumo-control` ahead; sm+); 'Operate chat' toggle `h-8 rounded-lg` pressed `bg-kumo-control`; step body `bg-kumo-tint` with `mx-auto max-w-6xl p-6`.
views.notes: While a flow runs, __root.tsx ShellFrame renders /inferops-canvas fullscreen (no AppShell), and the console sidebar still frames it. Back/Next/Finish are session events.

views.title: Flow step unavailable
views.reach: Run a flow whose step screen was deleted or whose workspace you can no longer open.
views.styling: `p-6 text-sm text-kumo-subtle` role=alert; loading 'Loading step…'.
views.notes: Flow controls stay usable.

views.title: Console setup
views.reach: On Operate home click 'New console' (?setup=new), or a tile's Edit pencil / settings 'Edit pages and starting screen' (?setup=<consoleId>&workspace=<id>).
views.styling: `mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6 px-5 py-6 sm:px-8`; h1 `text-xl font-semibold`; step list `flex flex-wrap gap-4 border-b border-kumo-line pb-4`, current step `font-medium text-kumo-default` (aria-current=step), others `text-kumo-subtle`; footer `border-t border-kumo-line pt-4` Back / Continue|Create console.
views.notes: Four steps: Basics, Screens and views, Starting experience, Review. Header, approvals and chat are hidden while configuring. Loading/unavailable states: 'Loading console setup…', 'Could not load console setup…', 'This console is unavailable…'.

views.title: Setup step 1: Basics
views.reach: Open console setup; first step.
views.styling: `space-y-5`; helper copy `text-sm text-kumo-subtle`; alerts `text-sm text-kumo-danger`.
views.notes: Alerts: workspace not ready for setup (use role/open error), per-workspace console limit reached. 'Create a workspace in Build first…' with none.

views.title: Setup step 2: Screens and views
views.reach: Console setup: fill Basics and click Continue.
views.styling: View cards `space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-4`; move/remove `size=sm` icon buttons; Overview screens as a checkbox fieldset; add row `flex flex-wrap gap-2` ('Add an existing screen' Select, 'Add Overview').
views.notes: 'Create a new screen' opens operate.builder.screen-editor in place.

views.title: Create a screen (in setup)
views.reach: In setup step 2 click 'Create a new screen'.
views.styling: `space-y-5 rounded-xl border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-base p-5`; h2 `font-semibold`; footer `border-t border-kumo-line pt-4` 'Save screen' / 'Discard screen draft'.
views.notes: Template Select appears only when the canvas catalog has screens. Section editing is the canvas editor's UI.

views.title: Setup step 3: Starting experience
views.reach: Console setup: continue past step 2 with at least one view.
views.styling: `space-y-5`; h2 'What opens first?' `font-medium`; notes `text-sm text-kumo-subtle`.
views.notes: Options: Assistant first, A view first with Assistant, A view first with side chat only (Assistant only only when editing a console already set to it).

views.title: Setup step 4: Review preview
views.reach: Console setup: continue to the last step.
views.styling: Mock console `overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-kumo-line`; title bar `border-b px-5 py-3 font-medium`; mini sidebar `w-40 bg-kumo-elevated p-4 text-sm text-kumo-subtle`; centered preview copy.
views.notes: Save failures show an alert under the step.

views.title: Discard console changes
views.reach: In console setup click Cancel.
views.styling: Inline alert `space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-kumo-line bg-kumo-elevated p-4`; 'Discard changes' / primary 'Keep editing'.
views.notes: Not a dialog: an inline role=alert block under the header.

views.title: Console settings
views.reach: Open a console and click the sliders icon ('Console settings') in the header, or 'Settings' at the bottom of the console sidebar (?settings=<consoleId>&workspace=<id>).
views.styling: `mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-8 px-6 py-10`; h1 'Settings' `text-xl font-semibold`; option descriptions `pl-6 text-sm text-kumo-subtle`; footer `border-t border-kumo-line pt-5` with 'Edit pages and starting screen' and an underlined 'Open configuration workspace' link (last Build location).
views.notes: Four customization checkboxes. Use-role viewers see them disabled with 'Console owners and editors manage these settings.' Loading/unavailable: 'Loading settings…' / 'This console is unavailable.'

views.title: Screens and flows
views.reach: On Operate home click 'Screens and flows' (?tools=true). 'All consoles' returns.
views.styling: The canvas.home page body rendered inside the operate page (see canvas.home for its styling); screen cards `rounded-xl bg-kumo-elevated p-4 hover:bg-kumo-control`.
views.notes: Inside Operate a screen card is a button that opens the screen into the session (operate.screen) instead of a link to the workspace canvas.

views.title: Workspace flows
views.reach: In 'Screens and flows', under each workspace that has screens. Also renders on canvas.home without Operate (no Start button there).
views.styling: Rows `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-kumo-elevated px-4 py-2.5`; title `text-[14px] font-medium`, meta `text-[12px] text-kumo-subtle`; Start (primary, with operate session) / Edit / Delete; 'New flow' button; error `text-[13px] text-kumo-danger`.

views.title: Flow editor
views.reach: Click 'New flow' or a flow's Edit.
views.styling: Form `space-y-3 rounded-xl bg-kumo-elevated p-4`; step rows `rounded-lg bg-kumo-control px-2.5 py-1.5` with index `tabular-nums text-kumo-inactive`; 'Add a step' group of '+ <screen>' buttons; Save flow (primary) / Cancel.
views.notes: Step count capped by MAX_OPERATE_FLOW_STEPS ('A flow holds at most N steps.').

views.title: Console widget page
views.reach: Open a console view, then pick a widget in the console sidebar (under the open page) or in 'Open a widget' (label button).
views.styling: `flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col gap-4 p-5`; ghost 'Back to <screen>' button; body `flex-1 overflow-auto`. Unavailable `p-5 text-sm text-kumo-danger`; opening `text-kumo-subtle`.
views.notes: Wiki widgets are read-only here.

views.title: Console widget modal
views.reach: In the Assistant header's 'Open a widget' popover, click a widget's 'Open in a modal' icon.
views.styling: Dialog `flex max-h-[90dvh] !w-[min(1000px,calc(100vw-32px))] flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-kumo-base p-0`; header `border-b border-kumo-line px-5 py-3` title `text-sm font-medium`; body `overflow-auto p-5`.

views.title: No triggers yet
views.reach: A Workflow-kind workspace with no bound hooks.
views.styling: `rounded-xl border border-dashed border-kumo-line px-4 py-6 text-center`; title `text-[13px] font-medium`, hint `text-[12px] text-kumo-subtle`.
views.notes: Loading shows 'Loading triggers…'; a load failure shows an alert with 'Try again'.

views.title: Actions waiting banner
views.reach: A Workflow-kind workspace with at least one pending action awaiting approval.
views.styling: `mb-6 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-kumo-warning-tint px-3 py-2.5`; copy `text-[13px] text-kumo-default`.
views.notes: 'Review' opens the activity review.
